newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Trade in Banco Totta suspended in Lisbon.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Banco Totta suspended in Lisbon.

text.p: Trade in shares in Banco Totta & Acores was suspended on Friday by the Lisbon bourse, a bourse spokesman said.
The suspension was ordered after a newspaper reported that government advisers had valued shares to be sold at a coming privatisation at 3,000 escudos.
The Diario Economico newspaper reported on Friday that the evaluation was made by ING Barings and Arthur Andersen.
The shares closed at 2,740 escudos on Thursday.
Orders lodged in the pre-opening session will be cancelled, the spokesman said.
The Portuguese government said on Thursday that its 13.22 percent stake in Banco Totta would mainly be sold directly to international and national investors.
The sale is expected to take place in November. Banco Totta is part of the Champalimaud group.
